summary.$t: How we cut the order screen down to the three questions support asks most

content.$t:
Most order screens grew one field at a time. We rebuilt ours around the three questions support agents ask most: what was bought, where it is, and what the customer was told.

## What we changed

The summary now leads with the status and the promised date, so nobody has to scroll to answer "where is my order?".

### Fewer columns

We dropped five columns nobody sorted by and moved them into the detail drawer.

### One timeline

Payments, shipments and messages share a single timeline, newest first.

![A quieter order page](/media/forest.svg "The new order page, with the timeline beside the summary.")

## What we measured

| Metric | Before | After |
| :-- | --: | --: |
| Time to first answer | 2m 40s | 1m 05s |
| Tickets reopened | 11% | 6% |

## What comes next

- [x] Ship the new summary
- [ ] Add saved views for the warehouse team
- [ ] Bring the timeline to returns
